answer: Operator-Scoped Identity Bond. Each operator must lock a long-residency deposit per identity it controls, and that deposit is released only after a sustained behavioral tide of clean interaction history. Reputation earned by any wallet flows to the operator's aggregate record, so a sybil cluster dilutes the operator's standing across its whole portfolio. An inlet of fresh identities therefore raises the operator's capital exposure linearly while its trust score falls.
